description: sflow_2d_curv_wavy_nh with the semi-implicit step and the coupled non-hydrostatic pressure (A 210 12, A 220 3, dt 0.2 s) on the wavy, skewed curvilinear grid (G 50 2): face differences along the face normals, divergence with the face lengths, the orthogonal Laplacian of the A 220 3 term, chain-rule cell gradients.
covers: sflow_momentum_SI_nh curvilinear: fdn, flen/carea, sflow_curv::lapcoef, grad5
nh_cell: cell discharges from the normal terms of both index directions
cell_update curvilinear with the depth of t^{n+1/2}
